name: Netlify Blobs
line: Store objects and key-value data for Netlify sites and functions.

free.text: 300 shared credits/mo; Blob quota unknown; pauses at 0 credits; no idle timer

cells.metered: No Blob rate; usage draws from shared credits
cells.regions: 5 regions; no regional price differences published
cells.selfhost: No, Netlify hosts the storage service

sql.math: There is no Blob storage rate or operation-to-credit formula, so the 1 GB workload cannot be priced.
Site-wide stores do not expire automatically. But charges for kept storage and idle time are not published.

files.math: 100 GB of storage and 1 million reads cannot be priced without the Blob rate per GB a month and the rate for each operation in credits.

jobs.math: Netlify Blobs stores data; it does not run jobs
